verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state ADK works with 'almost any generative AI model,' with adapters for Gemini and other providers including locally running models, and explicitly frame 'AI models' as swappable ('Swap the underlying intelligence of your agents by integrating with generative AI models from Google and other providers'). Model is set as a simple string parameter (e.g. model="gemini-flash-latest"), implying easy substitution without rewriting agent logic. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that swapping providers requires no code changes beyond the model field, and concrete examples of non-Gemini provider configuration.
